places.name: Hat Creek outfit's cow camp
places.note: Call returns from town without the new cook; hearing of Blue Duck he posts Deets as guard and spends the night on a nearby bluff watching the herd.
places.location_hint: herd bedded in a little valley with limestone bluffs about a mile to the west; about a mile from Lorena's camp; a day's ride or less from a town

places.name: Lorena's camp
places.note: Newt is sent from the drags to guard Lorena there overnight until Jake returns.
places.location_hint: barely a mile from the Hat Creek herd's camp, by a small pool

places.name: Creek where Blue Duck's trail vanished
places.note: About ten miles southeast, Deets loses Blue Duck's tracks after the outlaw rides into the water here.
places.location_hint: about ten miles southeast of the Hat Creek herd's camp

places.name: Town where Call hired a cook
places.note: Call hired a Mexican cook there and heard Jake's name mentioned in saloons but did not find him.
places.location_hint: within a day's ride of the herd's camp; Jake has been there for days

places.name: Llano Estacado
places.note: Blue Duck always escaped west onto its waterless reaches, where Rangers and soldiers seldom followed.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Maggie lived and died there in a room above a saloon; Call and Augustus argue whether it is a place worth living.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Comanche crossing near Lonesome Dove
places.note: Call walked out there and sat all night rather than visit Maggie again.
places.location_hint: on the Rio Grande just outside Lonesome Dove

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Call sat by it night after night avoiding Maggie, and rode up it alone for a week after she died.

places.name: Montana
places.note: In a low mood, Call half wishes to abandon the herd and the Montana venture.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus mocks the Texas Rangers Call led as half-outlaws who obey him blindly.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: herd bedded in a little valley under a full moon

groups.label: Call
groups.hint: sleeping on a limestone bluff about a mile west of the herd

groups.label: Deets
groups.hint: posted between the cow camp and Lorena's camp

groups.label: Lorena and Newt
groups.hint: Newt sent to guard Lorena about a mile from the herd
